topic: TensorFold (github.com/ashhart/TensorFold) exact-speculative-decoding technique extraction + sm_75 portability probe
source: MIT repo, full read (MLX kernels, CUDA families, engine, drafters, docs, tests) — distilled in notes/tensorfold-analysis.md
spur: arises from lab question: can its byte-exact drafted-decode discipline transfer to our llama.cpp/GGUF stack on the RTX 2080?

negative_result: mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k8.row.col.f32.f16.f16.f32 ptxas-accepts and RUNS on sm_75 but misdecodes: one-hot A[3][5]=1, B[5][2]=7, C=0 -> D[3][2]=7.03906 (should be exactly 7) + structured garbage (~(2n+1)*2^-23 in row 3, tiny values in rows 8..15 with all-zero A inputs). The .f32-accumulate plain-mma forms are sm_80; the sm_75 f32-acc path is wmma.sync.m16n16k16.

test: wmma m16n16k16 f16xf16->f32 bit-stability, K=64/512/5120, trials 512/512/256, mt19937_64 seed 20260927, inputs half in [-4,4), acc init in [-8,8)
chain_vs_scalar_fma: 16.22% bit-eq @K=64, 2.63% @512, 0.17% @5120 — the M3-Ultra 'MMA == FMA chain' property does NOT transfer to sm_75
row_neighbor_invariance: 100% pass all K — neighbors never change a row's bits
row_slot_invariance: 100% FAIL — same data at tile row 9 differs from row 0 (93.75% of mirror comparisons differ = exactly 15/16 rows)

verdict: fp16 tensor-core lanes are DEAD for byte-exact drafted decode on sm_75 (slot-dependent bits on both M and N axes); the lane path on this card is the INTEGER path (dp4a/IMMA) where invariance holds by construction — dp4a sanity: 0/1048576 mismatches vs host scalar int math.

ffma_fp32: 5.50..5.66 G-MAC (~11.3 TF vs spec 10.06 at boost — consistent)
dp4a_int8: 43.1..45.3 G-MAC (card's 89-TOPS INT8 rating is MACx2 — consistent)
crossover: 17408x5120 4-bit layer at measured 425 GB/s: weight-stream 104.9 us, HMMA row-time ~2.2-5 us -> rows_free ~24-48; agrees with fork kn-4 measurement: MMQ tile pass flat 55-56 ms n=1..8 (weights streamed once), mat-vec wins n<5
